description: Use before editing or reusing an owned game, or to check who has joined its lobby and is ready. Returns the prepared-content revision, rounds, question count, validation issues, links, and each joined player with readiness and how many questions they submitted. Replay definitions read the frozen edition: prepared rounds include questions; private contribution rounds expose only positions and counts with contentHidden true. Never returns other players' contribution content or gameplay.

runId.description: The game ID (runId) returned by create_quiz, list_quizzes or get_quiz.

name: get_quiz
title: Read a game's prepared rounds
